method: server-HTML harvest av 20 sajter (107-sajters-svepet 2026-07-06) → extraktionsagent + adversariell verifierare per sajt → triage mot det deterministiska golvet: expects uttrycker taxonomins beslut (tel:→lead, teckna→purchase, kategori-ingångar=start_flow); varumärkesord och 1-sajts-bevis rensades; 6 sajter refuserade (bot-block/SPA-skal), se "rejected" nedan — de kräver freeze-pipelinen.

rejected.notes: The fetched HTML is a Cloudflare "Just a moment..." managed challenge page (bot-block), not the real apotea.se site. No real storefront CTAs present. expectedSiteKinds reflects the vertical prior (purchase, plus account signup/newsletter) since the HTML offers no evidence either way.

HTML is a bot-block/access-denied page (title "Denied boarding", meta description "Boarding not Allowed"), containing only styling and a single anchor with no real conversion CTAs. expectedSiteKinds reflect the vertical prior only; the HTML provides no evidence.

The HTML is a pure client-side SPA shell (React/Vite, empty #root div, noscript "You need to enable JavaScript to run this app."). No visible link/button labels are server-rendered, so no real CTAs can be extracted. Preloaded modules (BookingComponent, StationPicker) confirm the booking-flow prior, but expectedSiteKinds here reflect the vertical prior, not observed CTAs.

File is the open.spotify.com web-player SPA shell: only script/link/meta tags and base64 config blobs, zero visible <a>/<button>/input labels in the server-rendered HTML. No real CTAs extractable. expectedSiteKinds reflect vertical prior only.

sites.notes: HTML matches the lead/start_flow prior: homepage embeds a multi-step loan application widget whose submit button is "GÅ VIDARE" (proceed), adjacent to user-agreement/data-policy consent links — the classic comparison-flow entry. Product nav links (Samla lån, Jämför lån, etc.) are funnel entries and count as conversion CTAs for this portal vertical. Excluded chrome: Logga in, cookie consent, Trustpilot, footer legal, phone/mail contacts.

sites.businessType: Pest control and home-health services (lead-gen, contact/phone driven)
sites.notes: HTML confirms the vertical prior: conversion motions are contact/phone-call lead-gen for pest control and inspections, plus booking of trainings and a "home health test" self-serve flow entry. No visible quote form on the homepage; "Anmäl försäkringsskada" and "Mitt Anticimex"/Webbshop excluded as existing-customer/chrome actions. No explicit "get quote" label found, so quote omitted from expectedSiteKinds despite the prior. "Identifiera skadedjur" removed as an informational tool without a conversion expect.

The server-rendered root page is a country/region gateway, not the storefront: no products, forms, or buy buttons — only 14 country links (funnel entry into the localized shop) and an app-download promo ("Download the Boozt app for free!"). The purchase prior is still correct for the site overall, but purchase CTAs live behind the country selection; on this page the only concrete conversion labels are the country entry links (kept as funnel entries, no unambiguous expect) and the app "Download" button. Trust-signal copy ("Fast delivery 3-5 days", "Easy returns") confirms e-commerce.

sites.businessType: Swedish price comparison portal for insurance, loans, electricity, savings and telecom
sites.notes: Server-rendered homepage with full nav. No explicit "Jämför nu"-style button labels in the static HTML; the conversion motion is category funnel entries (insurance/loan/electricity comparison pages), which for a comparison portal count as start_flow — consistent with the vertical prior. "Prenumerera" is a newsletter signup. BankID "Logga in" and cookie buttons excluded as chrome.

sites.businessType: electronics retail e-commerce (Swedish arm of Elkjøp Nordic)
sites.notes: Server-rendered homepage with real content. Confirms the purchase prior: dozens of product-card links to /product/... plus per-product "Jämför" compare buttons and a cart ("Kundvagn"), but no explicit "Köp"/"Lägg i kundvagn" labels on the homepage itself — add-to-cart lives on product pages, so homepage CTAs are funnel entries (deals/campaign links, product cards). Secondary motion is Kundklubb membership signup. Excluded chrome: Logga in, Meny, cookie settings, footer legal, store finder, category nav (incl. Kampanjer), and cart controls like Fortsätt handla. | start_flow tillagd i sitekinds: e-handels-homepage utan explicita Köp-etiketter — golvets ärliga svar är funnel entries (köpet sker på produktsidor).

Server-rendered homepage with full nav. Prior (purchase/quote) holds: the site is an insurer whose primary motion is entering product pages that lead to price/quote+purchase flows ("Se alla våra försäkringar" and dozens of product links like /forsakringar/bilforsakring). Secondary motions: booking free savings/pension advice, app download. Excluded chrome: Logga in, Sök, cookie/GDPR footer links, Anmäl skada (existing-customer claims, not acquisition), Kundservice.

HTML confirms SaaS acquisition motions but not the trial/quote prior: primary funnel is "Skaffa Fortnox"/"Se paket & priser" into a package purchase, plus a guided comparison flow ("Starta köpguiden") and booked meetings/demos ("Boka demo", "Boka startsnack"). No free-trial or quote CTAs found. Excluded login, support, cookie, career, and knowledge-guide links.

sites.businessType: insurtech (Swedish digital insurance: home, car, pet, accident)
sites.notes: Primary conversion is the quote flow via the button "Se ditt pris" (see your price, no href — JS-driven quote funnel). Product pages (hemforsakring, bilforsakring etc.) funnel into the same quote/purchase flow. No trial/download emphasis on this page despite app mentions; prior of purchase/quote holds with quote strongest. Excluded: help/FAQ, about, careers, social, legal footer links.

If.se (Swedish insurer) homepage matches the vertical prior: primary conversion motions are buying insurance online ("Teckna...", "Köp försäkring") and getting a price/quote ("Få ditt pris på..."). Extensive product-category nav (incl. "Våra försäkringar") and claims/service links excluded as chrome. No signup/booking/donation motions present.

sites.businessType: Digital mailbox service (Swedish digital post, receipts and payments platform)
sites.notes: HTML confirms the prior: primary conversion is account creation ("Skapa konto" to accounts.kivra.com/register, "Skapa privatkonto"). Secondary motion is a B2B funnel for companies to send via Kivra (För företag / Kivra Företag), but no explicit contact/lead CTA label is visible on this page. Login, cookies, press, and legal links excluded.

sites.businessType: nonprofit — Médecins Sans Frontières / Läkare Utan Gränser (Sweden), humanitarian medical aid
sites.notes: HTML confirms the donate prior strongly: header CTA "Skänk en gåva", a "Stöd oss" mega-menu of donation variants (one-off gift, monthly giving, Swish, memorial gift, gift certificates, legacy/testamente, corporate giving). "Bli månadsgivare" is recurring donation (donate, subscribe-like motion). Secondary motions: peer fundraising ("Starta egen insamling") and recruitment for field work ("Jobba med oss") as a lead motion. No purchase/booking flows present. Dropped "Läs mer om utlandsuppdrag" — informational read-more link, not a conversion CTA.

"För företag" is a B2B lead entry. Excluded login, cookie buttons, social links, footer legal, and plain grocery category nav.

The served page is Storytel's global country selector ("Choose your country" / title "Storytel - Select your country"), not a marketing landing page. It contains no signup/trial buttons — the only visible CTAs are ~30 country links that route into localized funnels (one, Denmark, goes outbound to mofibo.com). Trial/subscribe copy ("Start today with a free trial", "Subscribe now") exists only in embedded locale-string JSON, confirming the vertical prior downstream, but on this page the conversion motion is start_flow via country selection. Country CTAs above are a representative subset (deduplicated pattern).

sites.notes: HTML confirms the subscribe prior: the sole acquisition funnel is the "Prenumerera" header button pointing to prenumerera.svd.se/bliprenumerant. "Läs mer om allt som ingår" is an informational premium-package link (Läs mer-style, no expect). sites.businessType: Telecom operator (mobile plans, broadband, TV/streaming, phone hardware)
sites.notes: Server-rendered ecommerce/subscription site; HTML matches the vertical prior. Conversion motions are ordering devices with plans (purchase), signing up for mobile/broadband/TV subscriptions (subscribe), and entering plan-selection/trade-in flows (start_flow). Excluded login, search, cookie, social, and plain category nav.

sites.businessType: Smart electricity contract provider with dynamic tariffs, energy app and Grid Rewards (international gateway page)
sites.notes: This is the tibber.com/en international landing page, not a country storefront: the only conversion motions rendered server-side are country-selection cards ("Germany"/"Netherlands"/"Norway" under "Visit our local websites" — divs with JS navigation, no hrefs) and app-download badges (Google Play / App Store via onelink). The signup funnel ("Get Tibber", "Switch to Tibber", "Order") exists only inside JS locale strings, confirming signup/purchase happen on local sites/app, not on this page. So the page itself is a start_flow/download gateway; signup is the downstream goal, matching the vertical prior only indirectly.

HTML confirms the donate prior strongly. Primary motions: one-off and monthly donations ("Bli Världsförälder" is UNICEF Sweden's monthly-giving/sponsorship program — donate, with a subscribe-like recurring flavor). An embedded payment flow is present (Swedish bank picker buttons like Swedbank/Nordea and "TILL BETALNING"), showing on-site donation checkout. Newsletter signup (Prenumerera/nyhetsbrev) supports the subscribe site kind. Secondary: gift shop purchases (Gåvoshop) and corporate giving. "Egen insamling" starts a peer-fundraising flow on insamling.unicef.se (start_flow). Excluded chrome/nav, news "Läs mer" links, cookie buttons.

sites.businessType: Loan, insurance and electricity comparison portal (Sweden)
sites.notes: Server-rendered homepage with full nav/footer. HTML confirms the vertical prior: conversion motions are comparison-flow entries ("Jämför lån", "Jämför elavtal", "Teckna försäkring") leading to loan/insurance/electricity application forms ("Ansök idag", "/ansok" paths).
